title: [Bug]: Docker Image Pulls Have No Interval between failed attempts
body:
### Module

Core

### Testcontainers version

1.19.7

### Using the latest Testcontainers version?

Yes

### Host OS

Linux

### Host Arch

amd64

### Docker version

```shell
Client:       Podman Engine
Version:      4.9.3
API Version:  4.9.3
Go Version:   go1.21.7
Built:        Mon Feb 19 08:41:34 2024
OS/Arch:      linux/amd64

Also occurs using docker version:

[main] INFO org.testcontainers.DockerClientFactory - Connected to docker: 
  Server Version: 20.10.17
  API Version: 1.41
  Operating System: Amazon Linux 2
  Total Memory: 7653 MB
```
```


### What happened?

Test containers initiated thousands of container pull head requests during the two minute pull timeout limit.
